meta.description: Mobile records audio → POST base64 JSON → Gemini transcribe+summarize+extract → Google Sheet. Pair with n8n/voice-recorder.html on your phone.

parameters.content:
## LeadSpark Voice (n8n only)

1. Create Google Sheet tab **CallLeads** from `voice-calls-sheet-template.csv`
2. Credentials: Gemini Header Auth + Google Sheets
3. Paste Sheet ID on **Save to Sheet**
4. **Activate** workflow
5. Copy **Voice Webhook** Production URL into `voice-recorder.html` on your phone
6. Record 30–90 sec mock call (Tamil/Tanglish OK)

Webhook URL ends with `/webhook/leadspark-voice`

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, sheet_saved: true, transcript: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.transcript, summary: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.summary, language_detected: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.language_detected, fields: { name: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.name, phone: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.phone, budget_min: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.budget_min, budget_max: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.budget_max, locality: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.locality, timeline: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.timeline, purpose: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.purpose, bhk: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.bhk, lead_score: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.lead_score, notes: $('Parse transcript + lead').item.json.notes } }) }}
